Parhati Wohi ha Jo paper ma Dena hu, bas classes sari attend Karna q ka Kisi din parhati ha Kisi din ni, tu parhai wale din ki class miss hu gaye tu nuksan hu ga.
Cause asa teachers Jo Kisi din parhate Kisi din ni wo paper se Kuch din pehla Sara Kuch parha Deta.
Jis din parhati ni us din class activity Karna ko de deti ha.
Class ma late ana pr or chuti Karna pa koi margin ni deti. Attendence Sirf usi ki lagi gi Jo class ma betha ha.
Grade Wohi Mila ga Jo deserve karta hu.
